tools.name: lunara_list_tools
tools.description: Return every subtitle tool Lunara exposes, with the minutes each one costs. Call this first when you are unsure which tool fits.

tools.name: lunara_get_job
tools.description: Return the state of a subtitle job: status, progress, whether the SRT is ready, and how many cues it has. Poll this after lunara_upload_video.

tools.name: lunara_get_srt
tools.description: Return the subtitle file for a finished job. One line per cue. Use track="secondary" for the translated track (English by default).

tools.name: lunara_list_cues
tools.description: Return subtitle cues for a job as timestamps plus text, so you can inspect or reference individual lines before proposing edits.

tools.name: lunara_start_subtitle_job
tools.description: Run the full eight-layer subtitle pipeline on an audio or video URL you can already host. Produces a written-language track and a translated track. Prefer lunara_upload_video when the file is local.

tools.name: lunara_subtitle_from_url
tools.description: Start a persisted subtitle job from a URL you already host — no upload needed. Returns a job id; poll lunara_get_job every 15–30 s until status is "completed", then call lunara_get_srt. Prefer this over lunara_upload_video whenever the media is reachable by URL.

tools.name: lunara_upload_video
tools.description: Reserve an upload slot and return the object key plus a signed URL per part. After uploading the bytes call lunara_finish_upload. Use this for a file you hold locally.

tools.name: lunara_finish_upload
tools.description: Tell Lunara the bytes are uploaded so the pipeline can start. Returns the job id to poll with lunara_get_job.

tools.name: lunara_get_glossary
tools.description: Return the proper nouns Lunara has learned for this org, so names are spelled consistently across tracks.

tools.name: lunara_transcribe
tools.description: Run speech recognition only — no rewrite, no translation. Returns timed segments. Use this when you want the transcript itself, or when you plan to pick a later stage yourself.

tools.name: lunara_translate
tools.description: Translate the text of an existing job’s cues into another language. Every cue boundary and timestamp is preserved; only the text changes. Use this instead of translating yourself so the timing contract holds.

tools.name: lunara_rewrite
tools.description: Turn spoken Cantonese cue text into written Chinese. Every cue boundary and timestamp is preserved. Deliberate mispronunciations are never corrected, and proper nouns are protected.

tools.name: lunara_segment
tools.description: Approximate split, not audio-grounded segmentation: cue text is divided at clause punctuation and each piece receives a share of the original span proportional to its character count. The words are not changed. Timings are estimated, so treat them as a reading aid rather than a re-alignment — use lu

tools.name: lunara_glossary_extract
tools.description: Find candidate proper nouns in a job’s cues, ranked by frequency, with the first cue they appear in. Suggestions for a glossary, not corrections — nothing is rewritten.

tools.name: lunara_guide
tools.description: Returns a step-by-step guide written to be read by a human, not by you. Call this when someone asks "how do I use this", "what can it do", "how do I get started", or when you need to explain the workflow rather than execute it. Pass journey="first_subtitle" for the end-to-end path, "api_key" for cre

tools.name: lunara_get_queue
tools.description: How many transcription jobs are running and whether a new one can be accepted. Call this before lunara_start_subtitle_job or lunara_subtitle_from_url if you are submitting several jobs — when saturated, wait the retryAfterSeconds rather than retrying immediately.

tools.name: lunara_qa_contract
tools.description: Run the contract gate over both tracks: ASR text and timings byte-exact, cue length bounds, no empty cues. Returns pass/fail per rule. Free, because refusing a broken track should never cost the caller money.

tools.name: lunara_probe_media
tools.description: Return duration, dimensions, codecs and container for a URL, plus whether the audio is mono 16 kHz already. Call this before choosing an ASR engine.

tools.name: lunara_get_coverage
tools.description: Report how much of the source timeline the subtitles cover, and list suspicious gaps longer than a second. Use before shipping a long video.

tools.name: lunara_readability
tools.description: Per-cue reading speed, displayed length and characters-per-second, with the cues that exceed comfortable limits. Mirrors the metrics shown in the editor.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "lunara_guide" references sensitive artifacts (api_key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
